battlecruiser.description: Big mana and large threats. Lower interaction, higher impact plays.
battlecruiser.primary_goal: Ramp into expensive threats and win through overwhelming board presence or combat.
preferred_card_patterns: search your library for a land
battlecruiser.engine_notes: Prioritize ramp that reaches the deck's most important high-cost plays.

stax.description: Restricts opponents' actions, resources, untaps, casting, or combat.
stax.primary_goal: Break parity on restrictive effects and win while opponents are slowed down.
avoid_patterns: symmetrical effects the deck cannot break
stax.engine_notes: Score stax cards higher only when the deck can function under its own restriction.

spellslinger.description: Built around casting instants, sorceries, and/or noncreature spells.
spellslinger.primary_goal: Generate value from repeated spell casts, copying spells, storm-like turns, or spell-trigger payoffs.
avoid_patterns: high creature count with no spell payoff
equipment focus unless commander supports it
spellslinger.engine_notes: Cheap spells that replace themselves score higher than expensive one-shot effects unless the deck has a cost reduction or free-cast engine.

control.description: Answers threats, manages the board or stack, and wins once stable.
control.primary_goal: Survive, trade efficiently, generate card advantage, and close with resilient win conditions.
control.engine_notes: Interaction should match color identity and expected threats; permanent-based interaction scores higher in permanent-recursion decks.

pillowfort.description: Discourages or prevents attacks while building a protected engine or alternate win condition.
pillowfort.primary_goal: Make attacking you inefficient, buy time, and win through protected engines.
avoid_patterns: group hug with no win plan
pillowfort.engine_notes: Defensive pieces need a clear win path; do not fill the deck with delay effects only.

voltron.description: Builds one primary threat with Equipment, Auras, counters, buffs, evasion, and protection.
voltron.primary_goal: Protect and scale one major threat, often the commander, to win through combat or commander damage.
voltron.engine_notes: Single-target buffs score high only when the commander or deck cares about individual power, damage, or safe attacks.

group_hug.description: Gives resources to the table while aiming for politics, protected engines, or hidden wins.
group_hug.primary_goal: Shape table behavior and prepare a win condition while giving shared resources.
preferred_card_patterns: at the beginning of each player's
avoid_patterns: giving resources without a win plan
hard stax unless user requests it
group_hug.engine_notes: The deck must have a clear way to profit more than opponents from shared resources.

group_slug.description: Punishes the table with symmetrical or opponent-focused damage, drain, discard, taxes, or resource pressure.
group_slug.primary_goal: Apply repeated pressure to all opponents and survive the backlash.
avoid_patterns: effects that hurt you more than opponents
group_slug.engine_notes: Score symmetrical effects based on whether the deck is built to survive or break parity.

reanimator.description: Uses graveyard setup and recursion to return important threats or value permanents.
reanimator.primary_goal: Put the right cards into the graveyard, then bring them back ahead of rate.
reanimator.engine_notes: Avoid graveyard exile unless it is a deliberate finisher or emergency meta answer.

mill.description: Wins by emptying opponents' libraries or using milled cards as a resource.
mill.primary_goal: Mill opponents consistently while surviving long enough to finish.
avoid_patterns: graveyard hate that shuts off your own payoffs
mill.engine_notes: If the deck uses opponents' graveyards as resources, avoid broad graveyard exile.

theft.description: Steals, copies, casts, or uses opponents' cards and resources.
theft.primary_goal: Scale with the strongest cards at the table by borrowing or copying them.
avoid_patterns: cards that depend on your own narrow tribe unless detail supports it
theft.engine_notes: Theft decks need flexible answers because the win condition depends on board state and opponents.

tribal.description: Built around a user-selected creature type and its internal synergies.
tribal.primary_goal: Use creature density, lords, type payoffs, and go-wide scaling to win.
avoid_patterns: tribal payoffs without enough tribe density
tribal.engine_notes: User detail must define the creature type. Do not hardcode specific tribes.

tokens.description: Creates many creature tokens and wins through mass buffs, sacrifice value, or combat.
tokens.primary_goal: Go wide and convert token volume into pressure, value, drain, or lethal swings.
avoid_patterns: single buffs unless commander wants individual power
tokens.engine_notes: Token makers score higher when the tokens are converted into damage, mana, cards, sacrifice value, or board pressure.

infect.description: Wins by applying poison counters through infect, toxic, combat, or proliferate.
infect.primary_goal: Apply poison counters early and finish through pump, evasion, proliferate, or repeated pressure.
avoid_patterns: slow battlecruiser with no poison support
infect.engine_notes: The first poison counter matters; proliferate is weak if the deck cannot reliably apply poison.
